observations.note: Two supplied roots are FRAME recipes, not Dialog components or a size/variant set. First is named Dialog / 리소스 디렉터리 but visible title/content is scheduled-task edit. Finder is a large agent-discovery dialog. No root component API, trigger, scrim, dark or runtime motion was supplied.

Common r8/white/DDD1/title20x24 differs from AH r16/blue-gray/title24x32. Overlay two-shadow values match. Edit has no outer stroke or header stroke despite stored weights/bindings; Finder has all-edge EEE1 and header bottomDDD1, neither included in layout. Surface alias color/surface/blue-gray and Finder color/bg/blue-gray remain distinct despite same Light hex.

Both use finder/header2324:30419, source554x68. Edit override580x72 withpb16/no stroke; Finder1296x68 withpb12/bottom stroke. Show icon-button false hides only optional back button; close remains. Close is legacy2611:59907 ghost32/r4 with x24 source2199:23685, not existing AHIconButton32/r6/glyph20.

Body px24/gap24, field widths532. Name label20+gap4+control40/r8; Textarea label20+gap4+area140/r8. Toolbar actual37 includes top1 and ghost28 labels12/16/600; model sampleQwen3.8 uses20 image. Frequency card50 includes border2+padding24+row24; required label20/gap4. Repeat ghost24 label14/20/400. Advanced up16 visible. Count text, help, info, resize, inner scroll, time row and bodyfade hidden; empty visible wrappers do not invent content.

Actual edit footer is FRAME580x88/p24/gap8/end. Cancel source3025:25006 tertiary40 enabled width60; save3074:97439 primary40 disabled width88; labels16/24/600. This follows AgentHubDialogFooter composition but is not its source3151:20373 instance. Existing CMP footer host already owns p24; nest only actions or explicitly replace host, never double padding.

Body1296x732: rail192 + content1104. Rail owns direct168x32/r6 rows rather than AgentHubSNBItem or MenuItem. Search is explicit1064 atx24/right16 while1056 result rows fitpx24. Five rows each3x344x166/gap12; description310x40/maxHeight40/ENDING/maxLinesnull. All15 actual default source3095:20 instances, no automatic new card variants. Pin Booleantrue does not create a pin node in default.

Finder result section914 high extends beyond732 body and lower cards are clipped. Actual fade is RECTANGLE/GRADIENT_LINEAR1137x48/x-19/y684 alpha0 to1 of#F6F7F9 with opaque stop69.230771%, not an IMAGE. Overflow NONE and static11x180 scrollbar drawings do not implement native scrolling, drag, dynamic thumb or all-target visibility. Preserve visual fade without copying inaccessible clipping.
Edit uses legacy2019:3708 thumb4x160/r8; Finder actual3155:20473 thumb4x160/r9999. Keep instance paints in styles. A known AH scrollbar design is not evidence to replace all legacy bars.

Adopt modal/focus/label/description/close-policy/scroll-lock meaning through verified product primitive. Common CMP actual Dialog is RadixRootalias + internally composed DialogContent, not public Header/Body/Footer exports or custom closeOnEscape/outside props. Motion200ms ease fade/scale.96 is an adopted common behavior, not a Figma measurement; existing source reduced-motion reset is not verified.

Product owns trigger/open/close policy/focus return, edit values/validation/dirty/pending/save/timezone, toolbar/model popups and advanced disclosure, Finder search/scope/count/data/empty/error/loading, independent card actions and viewport behavior. Static focused Search or disabled save does not specify auto-focus or business enablement.

Use exact supplied/reused native glyph assets and dynamic model/tool-logo samples in dialog.assets.json. Header and scrollbar legacy sources are retained. Supplied fade PNG is a raster reference of a gradient, excluded from runtime assets. No full Dialog screenshot, live labels or cards become implementation images.

All732 captured node reactions are empty. Roots are Light snapshots; hidden branches are evidence, not additional rendered states. Runtime CSS, accessibility, keyboard/focus/scroll/callbacks, dark, narrow viewport and loading/error states remain unverified. Source/export stay unmapped and adoption draft.
